name: review-check-stale-cache
title: sd-review gates on a memoized check that reads live inputs
description: The review coordinator memoizes the typed sd-check per attempt and gates later runs at the same head on the stored report, while one constituent check reads an input the attempt identity does not capture: pack.review-scope reads the live PR body via gh pr view --json body, and the identity records prNumber but not the body (worktreeDigest is None for PR scope). Half of this shipped: 47d5dfbb (first tagged v0.66.2) added _record_stage and stopped persisting a FAILING check, so a remediated input is now observed. The stale-PASS direction remains, measured 2026-08-12 at 0.71.0 (run, templates/scripts/sd-ai-command-pack-review.py:1919-1932 persists a check whose status is passed): two invocations at one unchanged head with _run_check returning passed then failed both returned ready and called _run_check once, so a PR body that loses its scope heading after a pass is reviewed as though the gate held. Requirement is the full recompute contract -- recompute the cheap deterministic check every invocation, keep the local and remote stages memoized, and do not regress the attempt phase on a resume. tests/test_review_controller.py:1524 currently asserts run_check.call_count == 1 and encodes the reuse behaviour this task supersedes.
creator: sdelmas
notes: Found from a consumer (platypeeps/se-ai-command-pack) on 2026-08-07, same route as the three defects filed in 6f810484 from auditing hoa-manager. That consumer already carries the reference fix as a local fork of an install: "always" file -- bc01bc2 extracts _resolve_check and ships 5 guard tests -- so this pack reverts the fix on every refresh of it. _resolve_check exists in no version here (checked all 33 v0.6* tags across 1975 commits). Confirmed 2026-08-07: refreshing that consumer 0.64.3 -> 0.64.27 removed the fix and errored all 5 tests, so the refresh was reverted and the consumer is still on 0.64.3, behind 23 tagged releases (v0.64.4 through v0.64.27; v0.64.25 was never tagged -- 24 is the patch delta, not the release count). The 5 guard tests stub _run_check, so they pin the recompute contract but do not reproduce a live-input failure. bc01bc2's message also cites knowledge.obsidian-kb; that half was correct against 0.64.3 but is superseded by 7865666c, so do not carry it forward. Read bc01bc2 before designing a different remedy. Consumer-side record is tracked there as 08-07-review-py-local-fork. Re-measured 2026-08-12 at 0.71.0: _resolve_check is still absent from both mirrors, and the "behind 23 tagged releases" figure is the 2026-08-07 reading -- if that consumer is still on 0.64.3 the gap is now the whole 0.64->0.71 span, so re-measure rather than quoting 23.
